card.fires_on: Partway through proper names and brand names, mainly on the piece "ard" after a name start (Then-ard, N-ard-il, Rhein-ard). Also on pieces like "rd" in Lynyrd, "K" in LYNKUET and "alt" in naltrexone.

modes.description: A middle piece inside a drug brand or generic name such as LYNKUET or naltrexone.
modes.example: Advise patients to discontinue LYN<<K>>UET immediately

card.writes: Little clear effect; it promotes odd name fragments and suppresses unrelated words.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of unusual names, especially ones ending in "ard", such as surnames and drug brands.
